name: Subtitle bar
summary: Dark translucent rounded caption bar with one or two lines that slide up and fade in; for captions over video.

params.name: line1
params.default: This is the caption people read

params.name: line2
params.note: optional second line; leave empty for one line

params.name: color
params.note: thin accent edge on top of the bar; default the style's accent

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at

example.line1: This is the caption people read

author: krakujs
